verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents API endpoints for listing or restoring file revisions, or any documented version-retention windows. The only restore-related item is a ransomware snapshot feature with one-click restore. That is an adjacent UI capability, not addressable per-file version history via the API.

support.subject: As a developer, version history is addressable — file revisions can be listed and restored via the API, with documented retention windows
